title: coap_server.c:613 BUILD_ASSERT pins COAP_RESPONSE_CODE_CREATED==0x44; 0x44 is 2.04 CHANGED - CONFIG_LICHEN_TUNNEL_AUTH=y cannot compile
description: Found in security review of the tunnel-auth wiring (worker4). coap_server.c:613: BUILD_ASSERT(COAP_RESPONSE_CODE_CREATED == 0x44, "2.04 wire encoding drifted"). COAP_RESPONSE_CODE_CREATED is 2.01 = 0x41 (Zephyr coap.h; used correctly at coap_server.c:376/412 for 2.01 POST semantics). 0x44 is 2.04 CHANGED - the code lichen_tunnel_auth_coap_code(204) produces for permit() (tunnel_auth.c:30). With CONFIG_LICHEN_TUNNEL_AUTH=y the assert fires and coap_server.c fails to compile, so the tunnel-auth configuration has never been built. Fix: change the constant to COAP_RESPONSE_CODE_CHANGED. Blocks Zephyr-side compile verification of project-LICHEN-worker6-jzx5's fix in the real config.
